source.method: Disassembly listings from capstone 5.0.7 over the pinned image and ghidra-cli 0.2.2 queries on Ghidra 12.1.4 for cross-references, string search and decompiler leads. Both were leads. Each STATIC row names a signature, table or string check that the verifier compares with the pinned bytes.

descriptorFields.check: declaration compare reads six signature bytes
descriptorFields.meaning: Compared byte for byte with the first six bytes of a declaration entry.
Not part of the compare. Meaning not traced.
OR-ed into the unit data flags word by the UnitData constructor 0x00bd2660.
Size of the module work area reserved per control node by the UnitData constructor 0x00bd2660.
Alignment of the work area offset in the same constructor.
The control node builder 0x00bdb9d0 stores one pointer per slot at work base plus this offset.
Slots with an index below this value get a stored pointer.
ResolveStaticLink 0x00bdbf10 stores each resolved static link at work base plus this offset.
Same routine, second link list.

descriptorFields.check: module registration reads the name and stores the index
descriptorFields.meaning: NUL terminated path string looked up by declaration names.
Equals the u32 at declaration entry +0x14 in every installed declaration.

descriptorFields.check: module registration stores the parent descriptor
descriptorFields.meaning: Looked up by name at registration. The descriptor pointer is stored at +0xe0.
Called by ControlNode::UpdateConstruct_ 0x00bdc690.
Called by ControlNode::UpdateDestruct_ 0x00bdc8d0.
Called with the tick delta from 0x00bdbd80.
ControlNode::UpdateLeafConstruct_ 0x00bdc760.
UpdateControl_ type 0x12 through 0x00bdb6b0.
Consulted by ResolveStaticLink when no sibling matches.
ControlNode::UpdateDrawConstruct_ 0x00bdc810.
ControlNode::UpdateDrawDestruct_ 0x00bdc990.
Stored as the link value when nothing resolves.

descriptorFields.check: module registration stores the parent descriptor
descriptorFields.meaning: Written at registration.

descriptorFields.check: module registration reads the name and stores the index
descriptorFields.meaning: Written at registration and returned to the declaration compare.

veffFields.meaning: Sizes the Data::Effect graph A array in 0x28 byte items. Equals the sum of unit +0x1c counts in all installed effects.
Same for graph B. Equals the sum of unit +0x24 counts.
Pointer and count of 0x24 byte control instance entries.
Pointer and count of 0x1c byte control node entries.
Pointer and count of 0x38 byte unit definitions.

veffFields.check: veff instance count and size read
veffFields.meaning: Pointer and count of 0x48 byte unit instances.

veffFields.check: kill log reads the root path
veffFields.meaning: Payload relative offset of a backslash path string that the kill log line prints.
Pointer and count of 24 byte control declarations.
Copied to the effect culling box. Equal min and max select a default box.
Values 0 to 3, anything else raises the Effect_Data.cpp assertion.
Instance size is 2 * count + 6, at most 0x3fff.

control.meaning: Pointer and count of 16 byte records. Meaning not traced.
Pointer and count. Meaning not traced.
Zero or an offset up to the payload length.
Index into the declaration table. Rewritten to the module index.

link.meaning: Pointer and count of u32 link codes.
Pointer and count of u32 link codes.
Index of the control entry this node uses. A permutation in every installed effect.

unit.meaning: Pointer and count of u16 indices into the link array.
Pointer and count of u16 instance indices.
Pointer and count of 8 byte records: s32 start tick, u16 index into the child instance list, u16 zero.
Pointer and count of 12 byte graph records. The first u16 indexes the standard graph table.
Same for the random graph table.

materialElement.meaning: A name, reversed tag and flags dword whose bit 1 marks it unused, read by 0x00d85f80 with the flags at +0x14.
Passed to the model with the reference.
Pointer to an array of record pointers and a count.
Mapped by 0x00d815d0 and stored at node +0x46.
Values 1 and 2 are kept and anything else becomes 0, stored at node +0x45.
Bit 0 sets node flag bit 2 and bit 1 sets node flag bit 0.

slot.meaning: Selects the slot size in the table at 0x01305b50 together with the graph module width nibble.
Index into the unit graph A list.
Index into the bindings of that graph record.
0xff for none, otherwise an index into the unit graph B list.

graphRecord.meaning: Index into the standard table for the unit list at +0x18 and into the random table for +0x20. The entry must have a nonzero u16 at descriptor +6.
0 or 1, anything else logs graph overflow id error.

graphBinding.meaning: Offset of a u32 that holds the offset of the first segment.
Offset of one u32 start tick per segment, non decreasing and starting at 0 in all but 10 installed bindings.

graphSegment.meaning: 0, 1 or 2 in the installed polynomial graphs.
1 to 4, equal to the width in the module name.
components * (degree + 1) f32 values, component major, constant term first. Segments follow each other with no padding in the install.

instance.check: instance flag and unit index read

instance.meaning: Read by SetCullingType_ 0x00bd38d0 as an index into the draw layer table.

instance.check: instance flag and unit index read
instance.meaning: Bit 1 is tested by the lifetime pass.

linkCodes.meaning: unit local: bits 16 to 27 pick a unit definition (0x34 bytes in the runtime table), the low 16 bits pick a control node of that unit; resolves to the target work base plus 0x10

family: bits 16 to 27 pick a declaration; the unit nodes and then the parent unit nodes are searched for that module or one derived from it, then the descriptor provider slot +0xbc, then the default target +0xd8
fixed: matched by the node module index in the low 16 bits first, then falls back to the family search with a warning
rejected with the assertion not resolve static-link code

outcomes.claim: The routine at 0x00baecb0 takes a four word struct and registers its module table and its family table through Context::SetControlModules_ 0x00bade00 and the family setter 0x00bacce0. The CDev registrar 0x00b94a20 passes 0x010b9da8, which names 56 descriptors at 0x01300178 and 5 family rows at 0x010b9d30. The Rapture registrar 0x004e8870 passes 0x0111cbb8, which names 162 descriptors at 0x0130f4e8 and 8 family rows at 0x0111caf8. Each descriptor is 0xe8 bytes.

SetControlModules_ copies the descriptors, writes the table position to descriptor +0xe4, and stores the descriptor named by the string at +0x64 into +0xe0. The signature, parameter size, link storage offsets, default link target and the construct, destruct, calc, leaf construct, phase 0x12, draw construct and draw destruct slots are read by the cited routines. The remaining fields are recorded as data and their meaning is not traced.

The routine at 0x00bac950 finds a declaration by its name string, compares the first six bytes of the declaration with the first six bytes of the descriptor, and returns the descriptor table position. A mismatch logs the compliance version error and returns false. A name that is neither a descriptor nor a family former name logs unknown control and returns false.

When the direct lookup fails, 0x00bac950 walks the family rows and accepts a declaration whose name equals the former name of a row, resolving it to the current module of that row. Three of the 13 rows carry a former name: Scale3D, ColorRGBABlink and ScaleAll.

The Context constructor 0x00bad5d0 sets two graph module tables of 64 entries of 0x30 bytes each, the standard table at 0x01304350 and the random table at 0x01304f50. Each used entry carries a name, three size words, a data size and seven code pointers. Standard and Random each define Immediate, Linear, Parabolical and Polynomial graphs with Float32, X2, X3 and X4 value forms plus Genesis and SureGenesis forms.

The polynomial graph modules of both tables share three code slots. The routine at 0x00bec270 reads a segment as a degree byte, a component byte, two bytes of padding and component major f32 coefficients with the constant term first. The routine at 0x00bec2c0 evaluates c0 + c1 * x + 0.5 * c2 * x^2 per component, adds a carried array and 0x00bec4d0 evaluates the derivative c1 + c2 * x. The evaluator returns at once for degree 0, every term of degree 2 or higher is scaled by the same 0.5, and init zeroes the carried array at output + 4 * (components + 1). The double 0.5 sits at 0x00f59898.

The control node builder 0x00bdb9d0 walks the 16 byte slot records of a control entry. Byte +9 picks a graph record of the unit graph A list, byte +10 picks a binding of that record and byte +0xb is 0xff or picks a graph B record. The builder stores one value pointer per slot at the work base plus descriptor +0x2c, for slots below the count at descriptor +0x30.

Data::Effect::Create_Static 0x00bd3f70 accepts a veff root only when its u16 at +0x00 equals 0x1d and when every control declaration passes 0x00bac950. When it fails, the caller 0x00bc2810 retries through 0x00bd4760, which builds the effect from the context default root at context +0x24. A failed root with a version other than 0x1d keeps a lifetime of 3000000 ticks.

Create_Static reads the veff root arrays at +0x30 (0x24 byte controls), +0x38 (0x1c byte links), +0x40 (0x38 byte units), +0x48 (0x48 byte instances) and the declaration table at +0x58, and sizes its graph storage from the u16 counts at +0x1c and +0x1e.

The u32 at root +0x50 becomes the Data::Effect lifetime and the value 0x7fffffff sets the endless flag. The floats at +0x70 and +0x80 become the culling box and equal corners select a default box. The byte at +0x90 selects one of four culling types.

ControlNode::ResolveStaticLink 0x00bdbf10 resolves each u32 link code by its top nibble. 0 is unit local, 1 is a family search, 2 is a fixed search with a family fallback and 3 is rejected. Resolved targets are stored at the work base plus descriptor +0x34 for static links and plus +0x3c for expression links.

ControlNode construct, leaf construct, draw construct, destruct and draw destruct call descriptor slots +0x68, +0x98, +0xcc, +0x6c and +0xd0 with the node work buffer and the control parameter block. Calc calls +0x78 with the work buffer, the parameter block and the tick delta. Each construct and destruct phase asserts once through a flag bit in the node word at +0x1c.

The pinned image holds the doubles 5000.0 at 0x00fa9598 and 300000.0 at 0x00f67020. Effect::UpdateCalcRoot_ 0x00bc6e30 kills an effect that has bit 0 of the byte at +0x28 set once its elapsed word at +0xc4 exceeds 0x337f980. The failed-root fallback stores 0x2dc6c0 as the lifetime.

The frame driver 0x00baf3b0 calls effect slot 0xd4 and then Context::UpdateRoot_ 0x00baf280 for each effect. UpdateRoot_ calls effect slot 0x118, which is Effect::UpdateCalcRoot_. That routine applies the optional time scale at +0xd4, adds the delta to +0xc4, stores it at +0xd0, runs the unit time advance 0x00bce890 and then the control calc pass 0x00bcdd80. It requires the life control with id -3 and warns missing Id_Life otherwise.

Effects are created through EffectCreator::CreateEffect 0x00b99e40, which dispatches on the creator words at +0x10 and +0xc to 0x00b97d30 or 0x00b9e980. Two callers were traced. The cut scheduler listener CutEffectListener reaches it from vtable 0x00fbe71c slot 0 (0x00a06500) and the layout effect manipulator LayEffectManipulator reaches it from vtable 0x010a1abc slot 4 (0x00a87510). EffectFactory::Create 0x00b95a60 builds a CDevUnconformableEffect for kind 0 and a CDevEffect for kind 1.

The DrawResource draw slot at 0x00d667f0 reads the color pointer at work +0x20 and the matrix pointer at work +0x24 and draws only when the float at color +0x0c is above 0.0. The 16 byte state that the module keeps at work +0x10 holds a tick word at +0x04.

For resource kind 8 the draw routine 0x00d87180 derives the frame as the tick word of the state at work +0x10 divided by 5000.0, takes the column count from the u16 at record +0x26 and the row count from the u16 at +0x2c, and builds a texture matrix with the cell origin (frame % columns) / columns and (frame / columns) / rows. The scale is the signed cell size where the signs come from state bytes +1 and +2. Calc adds the tick delta times the float found through record +0x28 to the tick word and wraps it by 0x00d814a0.

The material binder 0x00d86010 reads a 0x2c byte element for each model part. It maps the blend byte at +0x28 through 0x00d815d0 into node +0x46, keeps cull byte +0x29 when it is 1 or 2 and stores it at node +0x45, stores byte +0x2a at node +0x47, and turns bits 0 and 1 of byte +0x2b into node flag bits 2 and 0. It then writes the draw color into the controlColor slot of the material constant table.

The per draw state routine 0x00c13770 applies depth enable from node flag bit 6, depth function from byte +0x47, depth write from flag bit 2, blend enable when byte +0x46 is not 8, the blend mode from byte +0x46, cull from byte +0x45, depth bias from floats +0x38 and +0x3c, alpha test enable from flag bit 5 and alpha function index 6 with the reference float +0x34. The engine setters map to the D3D9 render states 7, 23, 14, 27, the blend states 19, 20, 171, 207, 208 and 209, 22, 175, 195, 15, 25 and 24.

The mode setter 0x00c0efd0 handles modes 0 to 7. Mode 0 disables blending. Modes 1 and 2 use source index 6 and destination index 7. Modes 3 and 4 use 6 and 1. Mode 6 uses 5 and 7. Mode 7 uses 5 and 0. Modes 2, 4 and 6 use blend operation index 4 and the others use 0. Mode 5 changes no state. The index tables at 0x00f596e0 and 0x00f5971c map the indices to D3D9 values. The material blend byte maps through 0x00d815d0 to 8, 1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 6, 7 and gives mode 0 for a blend byte above 7. When byte +0xb8 of the setter object is 1 the setter stores the mode at +0xc0 and uses source index 1, destination index 0 and operation 0 whatever the mode.

The routine 0x00c13c20 registers 21 named material constants from the table at 0x013086a0, each with a byte size and a four float default, among them controlColor, modulateColor, fogParam, fogColor, textureMatrix0 to 3, uvofs0 to 3 and vfxSoftParticleParam. The DrawResource material binder 0x00d86010 writes the draw color into the controlColor slot.

Every installed vmdl root holds a shader set array at +0x18 with a count at +0x1c and 20 byte entries of vertex pointer, vertex size, pixel pointer, pixel size and a zero word, and a texture reference array at +0x20. Each shader record is a 16 byte key, a big endian length, 12 pad bytes and a Direct3D 9 token stream of that length that starts with the version token 0xfffe0300 for vertex shaders and 0xffff0300 for pixel shaders. The roles come from the install and from the creator that passes record +0x20 and size minus 0x20 to the shader factory.

In every installed veff the instances form a tree. Instance 0 names unit 0, no list references it, and every other instance appears in exactly one unit child list. The control and link arrays have equal counts and the link control index is a permutation. Unit schedules are sorted by start tick.

A control array entry carries the declaration index and a parameter block. A link array entry names one control entry and carries the link code lists. A unit lists the link entries that form its control nodes. The install shows these relations hold in every effect, the traced code shows how the lists are read.

The effect clock counts ticks. The division of a tick delta by 300000.0 to seconds in the resource kind 7 calc, and the division of the flipbook word by 5000.0 to a frame, give 60 frames per second when one tick is 1/300000 s. The unit is not tied to a frame source in this page.

The time variable x of the polynomial evaluation, the use of the carried array and the way graph B records modify graph A values are not read. The Genesis forms and the code slots of the Immediate, Linear and Parabolical forms are recorded only as addresses.
The parameter block of each control module, including how the position, angle and scale controls obtain their vectors and which graph output feeds them, is not read.
The model chunk with magic mxfv or vfxm that the vmdl root points to at +0x2c holds the vertex, index, sprite and material data. Its layout is not read.
The material parameter record switch in 0x00d86010 handles type codes 1 to 0x16. Only the color slot write and the texture matrix case were followed.
The caller that supplies the tick delta to the frame driver and the value of the time scale float at effect +0xd4 were not traced.
